DC-1.shift: the aged registered group is cross main A of a grid (pending: the feed main of a tree)

DC-2.shift: no aged registered group; an unverified valve on a grid's cross main (example: a tree's feed)

DC-3.shift: aged feed main beside an open cross main, at a density and K-factor beyond the examples'

DC-4.shift: no aged registered group; a ceiling sloped across the lines

DC-5.shift: aged cross main beside an open feed main; a 60 ft riser and a weak supply

DC-6.shift: aged feed main of a grid beside an open far cross main

DC-7.shift: aged cross main beside an unverified valve, no group left open by the register

DC-8.shift: aged feed main of a grid beside an open cross main; a ceiling sloped across the lines
